items.description: The reviewed source/build passes the established structural, security, claim, localization and generated-output gates.
items.boundary: Source/build evidence does not prove the canonical public origin serves the same release.

items.description: Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages deployment checks must succeed for the exact Phase 6 merge commit.
items.boundary: A successful deployment check is necessary but is not canonical-domain proof.

items.description: The canonical apex, www redirect, representative routes, real 404 and required legacy redirects must pass the external live audit.
items.boundary: Final release evidence must be collected after merge from the canonical public origin.

items.description: TLS, HTTP/2, deployed security headers, CSP, metadata endpoints and cache policy must match the approved production policy.
items.boundary: Repository header configuration alone is not evidence that the public origin served the headers.

items.description: The live contact surface and Cipher, Verify and Support public-host separation must be externally reachable and consistent with the documented architecture.
items.boundary: Reachability does not certify the internal security of the separate applications; Verify may intentionally reject a bare-root request with HTTP 400.

items.description: The www hostname permanently redirects to the canonical apex origin, and a deep-path test preserves both path and query string.
items.boundary: This verification covers the observed Cloudflare host-level redirect behavior; post-merge live-origin proof for the final release remains required separately.

items.description: Chromium rendered interaction, responsive, accessibility and localization checks run in CI.
items.boundary: Chromium coverage does not represent Safari/WebKit or every device/browser combination.

items.description: Firefox headless rendering is required in CI and produces browser evidence.
items.boundary: The Firefox check is a render smoke, not complete Firefox interaction parity.

items.description: Safari/WebKit behavior requires a real manual/device pass because the current CI does not provide equivalent Safari coverage.
items.boundary: Do not claim Safari/WebKit release coverage until an actual pass is recorded.

items.description: A real mobile-device pass remains outstanding beyond Chromium responsive emulation.
items.boundary: 320px/390px emulation is useful reflow evidence but is not a physical-device test.

items.description: The main branch currently has no branch protection/ruleset enforcing review or required checks.
items.boundary: Repository protection must be enabled in GitHub administration; documentation does not enable it.

items.description: A valid same-method pre-V4 versus V4 performance comparison is not available from the current repository evidence.
items.boundary: Current measurements may be reported separately but must not be presented as a controlled before/after comparison.

items.description: The largest lawyer-controlled legal page remains below the established 64 KiB release ceiling but is close enough to require continued monitoring.
items.boundary: Passing the current size budget does not remove the need to watch future legal-page growth.
